name: web-watch-strap-shop-desktop-and-mobile-combined-view
title: Compact view of the watch-strap store: outlined-word headline, product card, best-sellers and lime quote card
whatItIs: A long white page with tab dropdowns and a nav, a hero with a lowercase headline where 'black' is outlined in lime, a large black watch card with size and colour pickers and a lime add to cart, a 'shop by top collections' tab row, three product cards with star ratings, a 'why milanese loop?' text block with accordions and a lime testimonial card.
whatItMeans: Crisp and friendly; consistent pills and lime highlights keep a dense product page airy.
techniques: Use accordions for delivery and returns.
Highlight ratings with yellow stars in pills.
Use one lime block for social proof.

vocabulary.definition: A rating shown in a small capsule.
A coloured card with a customer quote.
